title: It's raining
summary: The weather changes, and so do the plans.

sentences.zh: 早上天气很好，不冷也不热。
sentences.en: In the morning the weather was lovely, neither cold nor hot.
My friend and I wanted to go out and play.
At noon the weather turned bad.
It started raining, and it got a bit cold.
We aren't going out any more.

sentences.zh: 我们在家看电视，喝热茶。
sentences.en: We're watching TV at home and drinking hot tea.
At four in the afternoon, the rain eased.
My friend said: 'Let's go to the shop!'

questions.prompt: What was the weather like in the morning?
why: Right: 早上天气很好，不冷也不热.
It only got a bit cold after noon.

questions.prompt: Why didn't they go out at noon?
why: Right: 下雨了…我们不去外边了.
The shop isn't mentioned until later.

questions.prompt: What did they do at home?
options: Watched TV and drank hot tea
why: Right: 我们在家看电视，喝热茶.
They wanted to go to the shop.
